selected.rationale: The Pet Parent has a category affinity for subscription boxes and pet health, matching the advertiser's new cat owner subscription box. Their preference for ingredient transparency aligns with the food samples included in the box.
The Busy Parent loves subscriptions and values time-saving convenience, which directly connects to the advertiser's subscription box for new cat owners designed to make early pet care effortless.

The Convenience-First Millennial is a heavy subscription user who defaults to what is easy, fitting the advertiser's business model of a subscription box providing curated toys and food samples for new pet owners.

rejected.reason: The Wellness Optimizer focuses on human health tracking and clean beauty, which does not align with the pet-specific focus of the advertiser.
The Gen Z Aesthete focuses on fashion and beauty with high price sensitivity, whereas the advertiser is a mid-tier pet subscription box.
The Affluent Classic prefers classic apparel and home goods with high AOVs, whereas the advertiser sells a mid-tier $35 pet subscription box.
The Sustainability Buyer focuses on sustainable apparel and clean beauty supply chains rather than pet products.
The Value-Conscious Shopper focuses on apparel, household goods, and discount-forward grocery shopping rather than pet care subscriptions.
The Fitness Enthusiast focuses on activewear, supplements, and workout recovery rather than pet products.
The Gifter is explicitly disinterested in subscription-only models, which directly contradicts the advertiser's subscription box business model.
